title: Kérek egy másikat: Asking for a Replacement

sections.title: Asking for a different one
sections.content: You already use kérek + accusative for any polite request. másik ("another, different") slots right in front of the noun: Kérek egy másik szobát. ("I'd like a different room.") When the noun is already clear from context, drop it and put the accusative ending straight onto másik itself: Kérek egy másikat. ("I'd like a different one.")

items.spanish: A szoba piszkos, kérek egy másikat.
items.english: The room is dirty, I'd like a different one.

sections.content: másikat by itself works exactly like enyém or tiéd — it stands in for a noun everyone already has in mind, so you never have to repeat the word for the broken thing a second time.
